run_pybullet_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a stadium SDF and a sphere MJCF object
apply_external_force: apply an external force to a pybullet sphere object using WORLD_FRAME flags
control_camera: control the pybullet debug visualizer camera to follow a moving sphere object
read_keyboard_input: read keyboard arrow key events to control forward movement and turning of a sphere
configure_dynamics: configure pybullet sphere dynamics with linear damping and red RGBA visual color
